scripts.build: BUILD_POPUP=1 vite build && BUILD_OPTIONS=1 vite build && BUILD_BACKGROUND=1 vite build
scripts.dev: EMPTY_OUT_DIR=0 BUILD_POPUP=1 vite build --watch --mode development & EMPTY_OUT_DIR=0 BUILD_OPTIONS=1 vite build --watch --mode development & BUILD_BACKGROUND=1 vite build --watch --mode development & wait
scripts.screenshot: npm run build && npx playwright install chromium && node scripts/screenshot-options.mjs
